instruction.text: Listen to the stories below. Choose the story that matches the addition problem.

b.sound: Hannah has 2 dogs, 3 cats and 6 rabbits. How many pets does Hannah have?
Hannah has 5 dogs, no cats and 2 rabbits. How many pets does Hannah have?

instruction.text: Listen to the stories below. Choose the story that matches the subtraction problem.

b.sound: Lan baked 12 biscuits. She gave 3 biscuits to her mother and 5 biscuits to her father. How many biscuits does Lan have left?
Lan baked 15 biscuits. She ate 8 biscuits. How many biscuits does Lan have left?
